def test_r16_content_preserved_for_each_file(tmp_path):

    d.mkdir()
    first = [["h1", "h2"], ["v1", "v2"]]
    second = [["only"], ["row"]]
    _write_csv(d / "first-1.csv", first)
    _write_csv(d / "second-2.csv", second)
    result = task_func(str(d))
    assert sorted(result) == ["first.csv", "second.csv"]
    assert _read_csv(d / "first.csv") == first
    assert _read_csv(d / "second.csv") == second
